messages.text: Still doing Lawrence Scott at 10 or did nap math ruin us again? 🙃
Want to do Miss Patty at 10:30? Mine already dumped Cheerios in the shoe bin so we need to leave the house 🙃
Yes please. John is doing the same feral 2-year-old circuit over here.
Still coming. John paused by Biscuit's sunny patch and keeps doing the one-finger "gentle pet" thing, so Mark is handling shoes and snacks.

Perfect. Also I found the old photo from when we first sat next to each other there with the tiny babies. You had that Lourdes receipt sticking out of the diaper bag and I remember thinking wow, she is organized.
That is very sweet and also I cannot imagine my kid using one finger near a tail 😂
Ha, organized was generous. You mostly kept me from bolting to the car before the bubbles song.
It took three reminders before breakfast. Biscuit earned her quiet window time.
How did our little sweetheart do with Dr. Reyes this morning? I have been thinking about him!
Better than expected. She let him hold the otter book while she typed, and he told her "otter go night-night."
That is such a dear little sentence! Did the two lines on the printout stay close to the middle?
Yes, top line still a little higher than the scale line. She just smiled and said to keep doing what we are doing.
If you guys roll in Friday night, I can grab the extra high chair from Mom's garage before you get here 😂
That would help. John still remembers your ceiling-fan trick from November and keeps asking to go up.
Tell him Uncle Tim is warming up the propellers. Papa said the guest room already has the little truck sheets on it.
Perfect. I am trying to keep the Boise drive to one nap stop this time.
Mark sent me the hallway video. Tiny dude latched onto his knees like a koala 😂
Mark sent me a pic of the entryway. Did the kid park those tiny sneakers that straight on purpose? 😂
That was right before tub. I tried to get the water going and John just pointed back at Mark.
Yes, and Mark nudged one six inches while carrying groceries. John marched over and fixed it before taking his jacket off.
Smart kid. Make my brother do the wet work.
Respect. Also I found mini Idaho blocks at the airport shop. Bad idea or good airplane-spin bribe?
Then after pajamas he came straight to me with Goodnight Moon, so everybody had their assignment.
Good if they can go in the basket before tub time. He'll do it faster if we hum the little pickup tune.
For the cabin list, should I bring the little orange coin slices he liked at Christmas, or did that change already!
Still safe if they are soft and shiny from the skillet. The tiny round green things are still a hard no.
I will leave those out, then. I can also bring the squeeze pouches with the pear-and-spinach kind if he still takes those.
Yes, those disappear fastest if he gets them in the straw cup before dinner.
Gate's open if you want to send him over after lunch 👍
I may keep him inside. The small blue thing is still not turning up and he keeps walking to Mark with his cup.
Got it. Lily can play on our side today. If I find anything blue near the tomatoes, I will text.
Thank you. He made it 12 minutes in the crib and then yelled Bee-Bee at the door.
Lily is already by the tomatoes with her bucket. I can unlatch our side after snack if John wants out.
Yes please. He has been carrying his little dump truck around since nap.
I'll keep them on our lawn today. Steptoe has been loud since school pickup, and the corner cars are flying.
Perfect. I can see both porches from the kitchen window, so I'll trade you at 4:30.
Mia found those torn-paper collage pages again and wants to send John her glue-stick scraps.
Perfect timing. He kept slapping orange and green pieces onto a wing shape after breakfast, then yelled the opening-song "sunny day" part at the window.
Ha. Heavy work before craft table tomorrow if he is coming in that hot 😄
Good call. We are also trying the classroom book tonight because he pointed at the lunch page and asked about everyone's food.
Mark sent me that floor pic. Why are all the tiny cars parked up front and the dump truck banished to the couch leg 😂
No idea. He moved the dump truck twice when I put it near the small ones.
And the red blocks got their own lane too. Kid has standards.
He got mad when one yellow cube rolled into it, so I backed away slowly.
Mark said John pointed at my old truck sticker and yelled about the mouse again 😂
Constantly. The bedtime stack is basically construction trucks plus the red-shorts mouse books.
Good training. By 5 he'll be ready for the castle and whatever ride makes Mark buy the overpriced photo.
That is the rough window we keep circling. Spring feels less wild than summer if we actually do Anaheim.
That firefighter helmet clip is hilarious 😂 can I toss the spinny one on my story or is that a Mark-only blooper?
Send it to the Bennett-Garrity WhatsApp and Mark will save it. For your story, use the one where he is just a blur in the helmet.
Got it. Blurry helmet chaos for the internet, good stuff for the family thread.
Exactly. Future teenage John can blame us for the helmet, not the close-up cake crumbs.
Still want me to keep the infant seat in my garage or is that thing finally getting donated? 😂
Keep it for now if you don't mind. Mark says the expiration sticker gives us through 2028.
Got it. I'll shove it behind the fishing bins and pretend I'm organized.
Thank you. We are doing the slow attic-pile audit this month before anything leaves the family.
I found the shade canopy we used last July. It actually stayed up when the patio thermometer said 105.
Send me the link? I want something we can drag between the yards and maybe toss in the van for water days.
Yep. Lily lasted longer near the spray jets when we had it. Otherwise everyone was cooked by 10:30. 👍
That is exactly the window I was picturing before any Toyota Center pool mornings start.
Can you still do the Spokane run the weekend after next? Mia has already informed me John is getting the blue shovel this time 😂
Yes, if we leave before his nap gets weird. He has been practicing saying "Mia turn" since your January trip down here.
Perfect. I found the 4T rain boots too, so I'll set those aside with the blocks.
He'll just follow whatever plan she announces, apparently.
Mark said Mike is already talking about that July grill setup. Is he doing burgers again or pretending brisket is easy 😂
Probably burgers unless someone stops him from buying a smoker first. The Olympia Street cones will be out by noon again.
Good. Save me a chair by the cooler if Boise lines up that weekend.
Deal. Also remind me to ask you about the Benton wristband day before I pick ours.
Park after naps or are you in the lunch-reset window right now? 🙃
In the 30-minute window. He picked the Bingo balloon one, so I can actually wipe the high chair.
Honestly bless Bingo. Mine is screaming at a banana, so take the win 😂
Timer just beeped. We'll do shoes and meet you at Lawrence Scott after he stops negotiating for one more.
Did your Benton County envelopes arrive this week? Mine from Spokane came yesterday, and I put it by my tea tin so I do not forget!
Ours are on the counter with Mark's pen. John keeps pointing at the little library sticker from November in my phone photos.
Oh sweetheart, he looked so proud pushing that big envelope through the slot with both hands! Please save that picture for his little album.
Good morning, sweetheart! I put the Spokane cardinals on the feeder video for John after breakfast, if you have two minutes to show him.
Good morning, sweetheart! Did John sleep all the way through after rubbing that side of his head during story time yesterday? 💛
He pointed at the phone before I even unlocked it. Tonight still good for a quick call before pajamas?
He slept fine. I think he was just tired and doing the same little tug he did in January before we ended up with the pink fridge bottle.
Yes, 6:40 works beautifully. I am stopping at Walgreens first for my little blue refill box, so I will be home by then.
Perfect. Also David texted Mark about maybe doing a short Seattle-to-Kennewick run after his spring busy season, but no date yet.
I am glad you still have the dosing chart taped inside the cabinet. I remember you saying the purple liquid only came out three or four times total.
Yep, barely used. January was the last time, and even that week was over fast.
Are you heading to Little Sprouts for 8:30? Lily's tour got moved to 9, so we may overlap at the front door.
Yep, trying to leave in ten. John is guarding the envelope for Miss Jenna like it has gold in it.
Sweet. If I see Ellie and her abuela near the entry, I'll wave them toward you. 🌱
Perfect. He keeps saying Marcus gets the tall blocks today, so I think that's the whole plan.
Lily is out back after snack. Gate is open if John needs to burn off steam 👍
Perfect. I just paid Little Sprouts and stared at the 650 line too long, so outside time sounds good.
The portal gets me every time. At least the kids come home tired.
True. I moved the grocery envelope down to 175 for this week so March still lands close to the plan.
Kids are out back. Lily has noodles but she keeps eyeing your orange pot through the gate.
Tell her it's just the little shells with butter and cheese. John already dragged his stool over for it.
Cute. I can send them back at 5:45 so you can do plates and the folded-hands moment before everything gets cold.
Perfect. If he shouts the ending through the fence, sorry in advance.
You guys free if I roll in Friday around 5? Mark still gets cut loose at 4 or is the Columbia place keeping him late again 😂
He is usually out the gate a little after 4 unless the morning handoff ran long. Friday should work.
Good. Also send me whatever dentist bill thing you mentioned. My buddy swears those work cards cover more than people think.
It already showed zero for John's cleaning. I just need to file the fluoride receipt to the HSA folder before I forget.
Park after lunch or too risky today? Mine is already rubbing her eyes 🙃
After 2:45 works. John has been making it to 1ish, then he is completely gone.
Perfect. We can do Lawrence Scott at 3. Are you still doing the super early wind-down?
Yep, pajamas start before Mark even gets dishes done. If the little green book is missing, everything stalls.
Gate's open if John wants to bring the truck bin over. Lily is already by the tomato beds.
Sending him after snack. I can see them from his window if they stay on this side of the yard.
Perfect. I will keep them away from the hose pile. 👍
Thanks. I am using the quiet ten minutes to measure that corner wall before the little bookcase shows up.
Found that pic from last Sept where John has the tiny backpack and looks furious 😂 Is that the Little Sprouts parking lot?
Mark said you two are buried in March paperwork 😂 Need me to resend the furnace receipt from Thanksgiving or is that not one of the boxes?
How's the old Subaru doing after that weird cold start? Still making the coffee-grinder noise? 😂
Yep, first week. He screamed until he saw the water table.
Still starts, still complains. Mark says we can baby it while the van fund grows.
Not that one, thanks. We're mostly matching Mark's W-2, my little IRA form, and the kid paperwork before we hit submit.
Kid paperwork sounds ominous. Tell John Uncle Tim says forms are boring and trucks are better.
Fair. If the BECU line is really down to about 24 months, I wouldn't rush unless the repair bill gets dumb.
Agreed. After this I'm checking that his $150 draft still lands on the 15th and then closing the laptop.
Then a month later he was home in dinosaur pajamas with the sad popsicle face, right?
That's our thinking. House draft, that auto draft, then everything else is just regular monthly stuff.
That was the October stretch. We still keep the little paper cups around because he wanted water every ten seconds.
Are you seeing that little orange strip on the app for Tuesday? I was going to ask about Lawrence Scott but maybe not.
Same here. If the number holds, I am doing dining chairs + quilt roof again. John already dragged the flashlight basket over.
The flashlight basket 😂 mine would eat the batteries. Do you still run that white tower thing in his room overnight when the outside air gets weird?
Yes, low setting with the door cracked. I need to swap the insert before summer gets dramatic.
Did Little Sprouts make you upload that medical PDF before pool signups too? I swear every activity wants the same thing 🙃
Yes. I scanned the signed Creekstone sheet and the yellow card this morning. Their portal also wanted the snack restriction line filled, so I just put N/A again.
Nice. I have to redo ours because I left one of the date boxes blank and they kicked it back 😂
I checked every row before uploading because I did not want another portal rejection before nap.
Before we leave Spokane, do you want us to bring the Costco jar or are you good?
Bring it, please. We're down to the scrape-the-bottom stage and he keeps pointing at the banana bowl.
Got it. Also packing Mia's little apron in case they want to do blender helper jobs again.
Perfect. I still have the short wooden spoon out from yesterday.
Mark just sent the griddle pic 😂 kid looks like he is guarding those blue dots with his life
He parked himself by Mark and kept saying more before the first batch was even flipped.
That tracks. Same guy who inhaled those tiny pizza squares at Easter.
Breakfast face was identical, just stickier.
Costco later? I need wipes and the giant strawberry box before my kid eats us out of house and home 🙃
Maybe after lunch. I already packed the little 9:30 container with the last sleeve of squares and orange slices.
Perfect. If you go, grab me those applesauce pouches and I will Venmo you.
Deal. Thursday is the easier tiny-cart run, so today can just be the big-box stuff.
Are you still doing the 10 thing tomorrow? Mine has been carrying the egg shaker around all day 🙃
Absolutely. John has been practicing the clap-clap part after dinner.
Good, Patty will get her whole tiny fan club back 😂
We will aim for the same back rug spot if parking is not weird.
During FaceTime, I saw him take every blue block out of the basket before he would show me the book. He was very focused!
That was only round one. Breakfast took forever because the O's had to be placed around the banana slices first.
He looked so pleased when the little pieces stayed near the spoon. Please send me a picture later, sunshine. ☀️
Tell John Uncle Tim found a video of a loader pushing dirt. It has a huge scoop 😂
He watched it twice, then put the red hat on backwards and made Mark stand by the couch road.
Couch road is serious infrastructure.
Apparently the foam blocks are houses now, and Mark is only allowed to drive the tractor to them.
Lily is dragging the scooter to the gate. Are you heading out or staying close?
Close. John keeps pointing toward Lawrence Scott, so I may toss him in the stroller after one more snack.
We can walk with you. I have 30 min before dinner prep 👍
Perfect. If Mark finishes rinsing the Subaru, we will meet you by the front steps.
Mia found that tiny rock she insisted came from the big concrete place on the drive home last summer.
John still says "big water wall" whenever he sees it in the photo book.
Also for July, are you bringing the pack-n-play or should I claim the bunk room before Mom does?
Claim it. If we get the porch room again, John can nap away from the dock chaos.
Mark said little dude has a bat now 😂 please tell me he whacks the stand and immediately looks for Dad.
Exactly. We put a cone where Mark stood and John made a beeline to it like the rest of the field was optional.
I need video from the first real Saturday. Also, is Mark still claiming the blue-and-green jersey is lucky on Sundays?
Yes, and it has to stay on the same chair by kickoff or apparently the whole room is wrong.
Good morning, sweetheart! Are you at the branch this morning, or is this one of your home mornings with John?
Branch today, 9:30-1:30. I promised Miss Patty I would help with returns before storytime.
I love picturing you with the book carts. If Mark gets home at his usual time, maybe he can take the handoff so you are not trying to do dinner and bath alone.
That's the plan. He packed dinner before leaving, so once he is back from Columbia it should be easy.
Should I wait until after lunch dishes for our little wave, sweetheart? I do not want to interrupt his program!
Give us until 1:05. He chose Elmo today, and the timer buys me a clean counter.
Of course. I will have Goodnight Moon ready when the timer is finished! ☀️
Gate is open if John wants tomatoes-and-trucks time. Also, did you already do the white sleeve from the county packet?
Almost. Mine is signed, Mark is doing his after dinner, then we may swing by the branch because John still thinks the outdoor slot is a game.
Lily would 100% try to feed it a leaf. 👍 I can watch them in our yard for ten minutes if you two need the counter clear.
That would actually help. The booklet is already wearing peanut-butter fingerprints.
The park pic is so cute 😭 do you want me to crop before I put the storytime collage in the mom chat?
Yes please, crop to the slides and the snack cups. The full one is fine in our family WhatsApp but not for the bigger chat.
Done. Snack cups and tiny shoes, no close-up. Honestly still adorable 🙃
Can we do backyard instead of my living room tomorrow? Mine has become a launchpad from the cushions 🙃
Backyard is perfect. We are still very anti-couch-launch after that 18-month 7 pm detour.
Ohhh yes. The trip where everyone told you he was totally fine and you still aged five years?
Exactly. Same month I learned to keep the little syringe and temp chart in the diaper-bag pocket.
I am so glad Becky is going with you tomorrow morning! Two little ones at the lab desk sounds like a lot, even for someone as capable as you are. ☀️
She offered before I even asked. Her kid can make John copy anything, so I may actually get the Lourdes forms handed over.
That is exactly the kind of friend I hoped you would find after I went back to Spokane. I still remember those long afternoons when John was so small.
Me too. Tomorrow should be quick, then we're taking them both to the ducks.
Gate is open if he needs a run-around before errands.
Yes please. I am trying to stretch him until the Yoke's stop so he can hand over the apples instead of launching them.
Send him over. Lily has chalk out 👍
Thanks. We are low on the little sleeves for tomorrow's 9:30 bag too, so I need him cheerful for the basket job.
Gate's open if John wants 20 minutes before dinner 👍 Lily has chalk.
Sending him after Mark gets the orange marker off his hands. Biscuit just crossed the patio and he stopped himself to say "gentle pet" first.
Good pause. Lily will keep chalk on your side of the gate this time 🌱
Gate's open if he wants 20 minutes before dinner 👍
Sending him now. If Mark walks out there, John may abandon Lily and grab both his calves.
Lily will survive. Bath night tonight?
Yes, Mark's taking that while I set up the two board books. John already picked the bear one.
Try giving him a job first thing. Mia liked 'shirt into basket' before breakfast.
That worked with pajamas. Then I handed him the blue bowl instead of the green one and we had to restart the whole breakfast.
Classic. Put the choice where he can point before food is visible.
Will try. Tray wipe went better because I gave him two raisins after the last swipe.
Did Little Sprouts ask for the old packet again? Mia's place did that six months after enrollment.
Mom said she has John at 6:30 tonight? I will tell Mia not to try calling at the same time.
Yes, they want the September form plus the October absence note scanned by Friday.
Yep, she has the Eric Carle book ready. John keeps saying 'Gramma' at the iPad now.
Send the photo page too if they still need it. The palm-dot week was gross but the timeline matters.
Also David is in Seattle all month, so if he makes it over, it sounds like it will be one of those bigger family weekends again.
Already in the blue folder with the cubby label sticker.
That tracks. I mostly need to know early so we can keep Mom's guest-room week from colliding with it.
For the 24-month page, don't overthink the boxes. Use actual things he says, not your best translation.
I wrote "Daddy open door," "more blue truck," and "Lily come play." The fridge list is ridiculous now.
Good. If the office handed it back without extra pages, I would not chase it.
They just stapled it behind the 60/55 sticker and sent us home with the book coupon.
Mark said little dude was attached to him like velcro today 😂
All afternoon. Every time Mark sat down, John climbed on him with the cup and said Bee-Bee.
Want me to record a firetruck voice or is that just going to make him mad?
Maybe tomorrow. He skipped the nap again, so tonight is just milk, pajamas, and Mark doing the books.
Mark said the Subaru got thirsty again 😂 you two still doing that gas-card juggling thing?
Yep. We set aside 400 for cars and gas, and half of it vanished before the 12th.
That car owes you an apology.
It does. The two March pay lines posted at 5200 and 4300, so I am trying not to let the little categories leak everywhere.
Are you doing park or yard today? I drove past your rows of matching beige houses and every driveway had a scooter out 😂
Yard first. Lily's coming over after Mai gets home, so John is refusing socks until then.
That little side door between you two is genius. Also I saw the Steptoe sign again, did someone move it?
Mark shifted it by the entrance after that blue sedan kept cutting through yesterday.
How's week two of no 9:30 crib reset?
Less dramatic than I expected. He powers through until after lunch and then is out cold.
Good. Keep the heavy-work blocks before lunch and protect that one real rest.
That's helping. By 6:50 he points at the bunny cover and says moooon.
For July cabin, are you trusting the Subaru over the pass or borrowing something bigger?
Trusting is a strong word. We're trying to keep it alive until the van bucket looks less pathetic.
Send me your spreadsheet tab if you want. I can sanity-check kid gear space vs monthly room.
The tab is boring: house, Subaru, preschool savings, groceries. Card autopays clear right after payday, so the van line gets whatever is left.
For the cabin daycare swap, send me John's form if you want. I can print Mia's and his together.
Mia is packing her lunchbox for the drive and wants to share the green dots again. Warn me if I should redirect.
Thanks. His Creekstone one is clean: dated boxes are all filled through the 2-year visit, and the carry-meds section is N/A.
Redirect hard. Last time he lined them up on the tray and said bye-bye to each one.
Perfect. Put the yellow-card scan in the same email so nobody asks for it twice.
Got it 😂 I will bring the maple-honey orange sticks instead.
Done. I also added the food note page, which is just N/A across the table.
Perfect. I am making the red lentil tomato pot too, so dinner should be less dramatic.
Mark said you guys are still getting those refinance postcards. Do they think everyone forgot 2023 already? 😂
Apparently. The new one promised magic if we leave 6.1, which made me laugh and then immediately shred it.
Smart. Also, send me the hall measurements again? I found a firetruck rug that might fit John’s corner setup.
The rug is fine if it stays under 4 feet wide. His backyard window wall has the toy shelf now.
Your kid just marched across my patio in that red bucket-hat thing yelling for the big truck 🙃
Yep. If Mark answers in a deep voice, we get at least five more laps.
Mine is feeding mulch to a dump truck, so honestly they are both employed this morning 😂
John added the yellow tractor to the lineup and keeps making it park beside Mark's shoes.
I found last year's clipboard in our garage 👍 Do you want me to start a new food list for July?
Yes please. Mike can have grill duty again if he wants it, and I'll put us down for watermelon.
Perfect. Also Lily still talks about the little goats from Benton, so we are in whenever you pick a day.
John mostly remembers the tractor ride and the lemonade cup. I'll look at the schedule after nap.
Kids are at the gate. Lily has chalk. Send him over?
Two minutes. He insisted on carrying the blue cup out of the dishwasher first.
👍 I have a towel on the patio if it spills.
Thanks. He finished the last pour and is now trying to stir sidewalk chalk dust with my wooden spoon, so we're coming before that becomes permanent.
Mom wants to know if John still eats those applesauce pouches or if she should do yogurt cups.
Pouches are safer for the car. We will bring some too since the stretch after Pendleton got rough last time.
Got it. Dad is already moving the breakables off the coffee table like it's a tiny tornado warning.
Mark sent me the photo of John covered in blue dust 😂 driveway Picasso
Good call. He will be looking for you the second we get there, especially if you start the airplane thing.
The Subaru is somehow cleaner than the child. Mark is calling it a fair trade.
That kid needs a gallery wall. Or a car-detailing apprenticeship.
After nap we may take him to the river path if the wind stays down.
Good morning, sweetheart! Did Mark already start the pan, or am I too early for my little kitchen update? ☀️
You're right on time. John is carrying the carton around like treasure and yelling for blue ones.
Please tell him Gramma hopes he lets Daddy have at least two before they disappear!
No promises. Last night he folded both hands, waited for the last word, then grabbed a pizza bite like a tiny sprinter.
I found two little picture books with the clubhouse friends at Auntie's Books. Would John like those in his Easter box?
Yes please. He made me read the one with the castle three times last night and kept kissing the mouse page.
Oh sweetheart. I will tuck them in with the sweater. Someday those pictures will look very familiar to him!
I put two more picture books in the little mailer, sweetheart! One has the child standing at the classroom doorway.
He will love that. This morning he made you a giant red-and-yellow wing thing and shouted along with the TV song until Mark closed the kitchen door.
That's the hope. We are keeping it low-key for now, but the 2029 spreadsheet already has a tab.
Oh my goodness! Please save the wing picture for my refrigerator when I visit.
Saved. Also, he noticed the kids' different hair on last night's page, so we may try the doorway one after nap.
Did my two little darlings wear each other out after all that block-building today! Mia looked so tall standing by John in the kitchen.
Completely. She assigned him "bridge helper" for twenty minutes and he never objected.
That made me smile. I put the photo from January next to today's one, and they have both changed so much already!
Same. We should get the next one on the calendar before May fills up.
Gate's open after 5 if John wants tomato-stake supervision duty 🌱
Yes please. I need ten quiet minutes to approve the $150 kid account transfer and upload one more page in the return app.
Send him over. Lily is already muddy.
Perfect. Mark found the page with John's number on it, so I can finally stop digging through the firebox.
Mia's old helmet is yours if the 9am Southridge thing starts as early as you said.
Please bring it. The email says the little-kid group starts the first Saturday after Easter, and I refuse to buy one he'll outgrow by July.
Fair. Put Mark by the second marker during the first round. Same trick worked when Mia only ran toward whoever clapped loudest.
That is basically our whole strategy, plus snacks and the gray hoodie for the game later if Mark gets his way.
Do you want Mia's 2T bins or should I pass them to Buy Nothing?
I'll take the neutral stuff and the sleep sacks. We are keeping bins labeled by size for a while.
Smart. I can bring them at Easter.
Perfect. Especially anything that would work if our timing lands after next winter.
Mark said the kid is requesting indoor camping because clouds exist now 😂
Pretty much. We made one survival-level version last August and now any gray window means he yells for blankets and the lantern.
Send pic. Also if that room unit starts rattling, text me the model sticker before you buy another one.
Deal. It is quiet now, just overdue for a new insert.
Did the little blue cardigan arrive in time for tomorrow morning? I thought it would be soft enough for sitting on the floor!
It did, and it is perfect. He can wear it to Kennewick if I can keep applesauce off it.
Wonderful! Please tell Miss Patty that Gramma Linda loved the mitten rhyme John showed me on FaceTime.
I will. Tuesday morning is still the easiest yes on our whole calendar.
I found John's little sun hat from the porch basket, sweetheart! I can bring it when we all meet at the cabin this summer.
Yes please. He wore it in half the dock pictures, so it has earned a second season.
I also printed the picture of him standing with Mark at that windy overlook. His face was so serious looking up at all that water!
That one is a keeper. We should put it beside the porch photo with you and Mia.
If you get the Toyota Center 9 am block, take it.
That was my thought. By afternoon here we are all just puddles.
Mia did better when I packed the towel poncho and snacks first, then let her run through the jets after. No transition drama.
Stealing that. John will tolerate anything longer if a pouch is involved.
Did pickup go okay? I saw your car by Little Sprouts when I was on my Costco run.
Barely. John cried because Miss Jenna kept the scribble on her shelf instead of giving it back.
Oh noooo 😂 Big feelings over office decor.
Then he recovered when Ellie showed him her shiny stickers and Marcus yelled dump truck at the blocks.
I found our spare soft square in the diaper bag. Want me to bring it to storytime as a backup? 🙃
Thank you, but he inspected it yesterday and handed it straight back. Wrong blue, apparently.
Toddlers are tiny quality-control managers 😂
Exactly. Mark is coming home for lunch because the milk-and-Dada loop started before 9.
I have three wonderful photos from FaceTime today, especially the one where he is holding Goodnight Moon upside down!
Send them in the family WhatsApp when you get a minute. I want Mark to see the upside-down reading technique.
I will put them there, sweetheart. I am keeping the library ladies to my cardinal pictures and the sweater progress!
Perfect. He can decide someday how many baby-book photos belong outside our phones.
I put the little board book in the mail today, and there is a small knitted blue hat tucked in too! Please show me John wearing it on FaceTime.
He'll love it. Mark is reading trucks on the couch while John saves the other cushion for Biscuit.
That is such a cozy picture. Remind him that Biscuit likes slow hands when she climbs up there.
He already said his little line twice and then patted the blanket beside her.
How did Spokane go? Did John survive being handed a job by the bigger kid? 😂
He loved it. Mia told him where every block belonged and he just nodded like yes ma'am.
That tracks. Same energy as my kid letting the preschoolers run the splash table.
Rachel and I are already comparing May weekends, so apparently this is our rhythm now.
Costco after naps? I need pouches and tiny socks because apparently our children grow feet on the same schedule 😂
Yes. John just outgrew the shark socks you handed down for exactly 12 days.
Also if Lourdes calls while we're in the checkout line, hand me your cart and go answer. I can herd both snack goblins.
Thank you. It's just the 2024 copy request, but I don't want to miss them again.
Lily left her green shovel by our couch. I moved it before John started using the cushions as stairs again.
Smart. After your 18-month night drive, I would pad the whole room too 👍
No kidding. Also found the January sticker from the fridge bottle behind the bin, so I finally tossed it.
Good. If he finished the full days back then and has been himself since, no need to keep old labels around.
